days.heading: Arrive Palermo and settle into Cefalù

facts.label: Gateway
facts.valueHtml: Arrive PMO, then collect the Sicily car

facts.label: Drive
facts.valueHtml: PMO -> Cefalù ~75-90 min; pick up rental at PMO

days.note: Use Palermo as the arrival gateway, collect the rental car, and keep the first Cefalù evening deliberately light. The exact inbound routing belongs to the composed transfer edge, not this leg.

spots.name: Cefalù old town + beach + La Rocca
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · CefalùIG · La RoccaFlickr

images.alt: An aerial sweep over Cefalù's medieval roofs, beach, and turquoise sea.
Cefalù's waterfront and La Rocca glowing at dusk from the sea.
Cefalù's beach and old town tucked beneath the sheer La Rocca.

spots.cost: Beach/old town are free. La Rocca urban park is currently EUR5 full / EUR2.50 reduced ages 6-14; family estimate about EUR15.
spots.climate: Mid-June: warm coastal days, often upper 70s to low 80s F. Sea commonly runs about 72-75 F by mid/late June.
spots.saveHtml: Save Make the best day nearly free: beach, old town, sunset harbor, grocery breakfast, and La Rocca only if the morning is cool.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Rent a beach set or do a short boat outing along the coast; confirm the chair/umbrella price before sitting.
spots.restoHtml:
• Bottega Tivitti — pizzeria/burger seafront option; pizza, burgers, fries
  • Pasta e Pasti — casual pasta counter; tomato pasta and simple shapes work
  • 'Nna Principi — Italian/pizza spot with Margherita and penne pasta mentioned in current reviews
spots.altboxHtml:
• Campofelice di Roccella ↩ — less postcard charm, but sometimes better-value beach lodging with parking.
  • Kalura Beach ↗ — clearer rocky cove near Cefalu when the town beach is crowded.
  • Monreale Cathedral ↗ — mosaic-heavy indoor/culture swap if Palermo street heat is too much.
spots.bloglinksHtml: La Rocca practical guide ↗Cefalù restaurant ideas ↗

days.heading: Cefalù beach day + La Rocca

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Morning La Rocca if cool, long beach block, old-town dinner

days.note: Make this the first full warm-water day: hike La Rocca while it is cool, then leave a long afternoon for the beach and an old-town dinner.

days.heading: Palermo taste + Mondello option

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Palermo core, street food, optional Mondello swim

facts.label: Choice
facts.valueHtml: Chapel/mosaics or beach, not both if heat is high

days.note: Palermo gives Sicily its city texture, but the day stays flexible because kids may prefer Mondello after two hot hours in town.

spots.name: Palermo historic core + Mondello
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · PalermoIG · MondelloFlickr

images.alt: Palermo's Baroque rooftops and church towers glowing in golden evening light.
Palermo's grand historic square framed by mountains and ornate façades.
A dramatic Sicilian coastal scene in clear morning light.

spots.cost: Street wandering is free. Palazzo dei Normanni / Palatine Chapel official current adult tickets vary by day/access; plan roughly EUR15.50-EUR19.50 adult and check the exact calendar.
spots.climate: June: Palermo is hotter and less breezy than Cefalù. Do culture early, then use Mondello for afternoon water if the city gets heavy.
spots.saveHtml: Save Train from Cefalù into Palermo avoids city parking; Palermo-Cefalù rail is frequent and cheap enough for a family city day.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Palatine Chapel/Norman Palace is the paid anchor if mosaics matter; skip it if the kids need beach more than gold ceilings.
spots.restoHtml:
• Bottega Tivitti — pizzeria/burger seafront option; pizza, burgers, fries
  • Pasta e Pasti — casual pasta counter; tomato pasta and simple shapes work
  • 'Nna Principi — Italian/pizza spot with Margherita and penne pasta mentioned in current reviews
spots.altboxHtml:
• Monreale Cathedral ↩ — another mosaic masterpiece if Palermo feels too intense.
  • Mondello Beach ↗ — classic Palermo swim day when the kids need sand over churches.
  • Campofelice di Roccella ↗ — less charming than Cefalu, but easier parking and often better-value beach lodging.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Official Norman Palace visit info ↗Palermo practical tips ↗

days.heading: Juneteenth transfer to the Taormina coast

facts.label: Drive
facts.valueHtml: Cefalù -> Giardini-Naxos ~2.5-3 hr on the A20/A18

days.note: The federal holiday lands exactly on the long transfer day, so it costs nothing. Arrive by early afternoon, Isola Bella swim, Taormina evening up the hill if energy allows.

spots.name: Taormina + Isola Bella
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · TaorminaIG · Isola BellaFlickr

images.alt: Taormina's sunlit coastline sweeping from Isola Bella toward Mount Etna.
Isola Bella floating in brilliant turquoise water below Taormina.
The Ionian-blue cove around Taormina's Isola Bella.

spots.cost: Ancient Theatre official current fare: EUR14 full / EUR7 reduced. Isola Bella beach is free; beach sets/boat extras vary.
spots.climate: Mid/late June: warm to hot, with Ionian water around 72-75 F.
spots.saveHtml: Save Stay below Taormina and use cable car/taxi into town; avoid old-town parking and lodging premiums.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Greek Theatre at golden hour plus an Isola Bella boat/swim stop; budget $120-250 family depending tour style.
spots.restoHtml:
• Bam Bar — granita/brioche stop; easy snack win near Taormina old town
  • Da Cristina — arancini, pizza/focaccia-style quick food, fries-like comfort sides nearby
  • La Capinera / beach alternatives — Giardini-Naxos has broad pizza, pasta, burger, and beach-lunch options if Taormina menus are too adult
spots.altboxHtml:
• Giardini-Naxos beach ↩ — easier beach logistics and lower prices if Taormina is crowded.
  • Castelmola ↗ — hilltop village above Taormina for views without committing to a beach afternoon.
  • Letojanni Beach ↗ — lower-key beach town north of Taormina when Isola Bella is packed.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Official theatre tickets ↗Taormina theatre guide ↗

days.heading: Etna morning, coast afternoon

facts.label: Plan B
facts.valueHtml: Cable car only if weather is clear

days.note: Etna is the nature pillar, not an automatic expensive summit day. Check visibility and volcanic conditions before buying anything above the free crater walks.

spots.name: Mount Etna south slope
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Mount EtnaFlickr

images.alt: Red-and-black volcanic craters spread across Etna's south slope.
Mount Etna's lava fields and pine forest in golden-hour light.
An ash road crossing volcanic cones beneath Etna's blue sky.

spots.cost: Free Silvestri craters are the budget plan. Cable-car-only prices have been reported around EUR50 adult / EUR30 kids 5-10; 4x4/guided higher-slope options can push a family toward EUR250-EUR320.
spots.climate: Mountain day: cooler and windier than the coast. Visibility drives value; do not buy expensive summit options if clouds/ash are poor.
spots.saveHtml: Save Walk Silvestri craters for free, then spend the money on a beach dinner or boat day.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Cable car or 4x4 only on a clear morning; the 13-year-old will get more out of it than the 8-year-old if the weather cooperates.
spots.restoHtml:
• Bam Bar — granita/brioche stop; easy snack win near Taormina old town
  • Da Cristina — arancini, pizza/focaccia-style quick food, fries-like comfort sides nearby
  • La Capinera / beach alternatives — Giardini-Naxos has broad pizza, pasta, burger, and beach-lunch options if Taormina menus are too adult
spots.altboxHtml:
• Alcantara Gorge ↩ — cool-water nature day if Etna weather is bad or crater access is restricted.
  • Letojanni Beach ↗ — lower-key beach town north of Taormina when Isola Bella is packed.
  • Giardini-Naxos beach ↗ — more space, easier food, and simpler parking than tiny Isola Bella.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Etna cable-car price proxy ↗Etna 4x4 price proxy ↗

days.heading: Isola Bella / Giardini-Naxos final swim

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Beach/boat, easy packing, Catania airport prep

days.note: End with water, not another town checklist. The whole point of handing swimming to Sicily was a real Mediterranean beach finish.
